input.question: Which person or organization did Guillaume Fontaine work for?

documents.text:
Here is a potential Wikipedia entry that presents comprehensive evidence for the statement:

Guillaume Fontaine

Guillaume Fontaine is a researcher who has made significant contributions to the field of cardiovascular research. According to his ORCID ID, 0000-0002-7806-814X, Fontaine has published numerous papers and collaborated with various institutions throughout his career. Career

Fontaine has worked at the Montreal Heart Institute, a renowned hospital in Canada dedicated to cardiovascular care and research. This affiliation is supported by multiple sources, including his ORCID profile, which lists the Montreal Heart Institute as one of his affiliations. [1]

Additionally, a search of the Montreal Heart Institute's website reveals Fontaine's name among the list of researchers and staff members. [2] Furthermore, several research papers co-authored by Fontaine and published in reputable scientific journals, such as the Journal of the American College of Cardiology and Circulation, acknowledge the Montreal Heart Institute as his affiliation. [3][4]

[2] Montreal Heart Institute. (n.d.). Research Team. Retrieved from <https:\/\/www.icm-mhi.org\/en\/research\/research-team\/>

[3] Fontaine, G., et al. (2020). Association of Cardiac Troponin with Cardiovascular Outcomes in Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease. Journal of the American College of Cardiology, 75(11), 1331–1342. doi: 10.1016\/j.jacc.2020.02.052

[4] Fontaine, G., et al. (2019). Impact of Diabetes on Cardiovascular Outcomes in Patients with Acute Coronary Syndrome. Circulation, 139(10), 1231–1242.
